MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 7 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 9
   C. 16
   D. 7

2. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

4. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 25

5. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 13

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 21
   D. 9

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 64

10. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 48

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
